Functions and mechanism of acetylene carbon black: Acetylene carbon black is pure amorphous carbon with excellent water absorption and adsorptivity, small resistivity and good conductivity. With black used, the conductivity of the lead active material is increased. In particular, during post-discharge, if the lead sulfate crystal is increased significantly, the feature of improving conductivity of lead active substances is more obvious.
